children.value: Is the Vaporesso iTank T better than the iTank 2?

Yes for leak resistance and refilling: the Vaporesso iTank T moves the airflow to the top, so e-liquid cannot seep out of the airflow slots, and it fills through a sliding cap. The Vaporesso iTank 2 keeps bottom airflow with a flip-top cap. Both run the same GTi mesh coils, so flavour is close.

The Vaporesso iTank T is the best choice for DTL vapers who want top airflow and a tank that will not leak on its side. The Vaporesso iTank 2 suits anyone who already owns GTi coils and prefers bottom airflow. For a tight mouth-to-lung draw, pick the Vaporesso iTank X or Vaporesso iTank M instead.
Which coils fit the Vaporesso iTank T?

only: 0.15Ω (75 to 90W), 0.2Ω (60 to 75W), 0.4Ω (50 to 60W) and 0.5Ω (30 to 40W), plus the GTi 0.2Ω dual mesh. GTX, MTX and GT coils from other Vaporesso tanks do not fit. Coils are press-fit, so they push straight in without threads.
Does the Vaporesso iTank T fit my mod?

Yes if the mod has a standard 510 thread and can output at least 30W. The Vaporesso iTank T is 24.5mm wide, so it sits flush on box mods such as the Vaporesso Armour S, Gen 200, Gen Max and Gen SE, but it overhangs slim 22mm tube mods and will not fit pod kits.
Why is my Vaporesso iTank T leaking or gurgling?

Gurgling on the Vaporesso iTank T usually means the GTi coil is flooded. Use a 70VG or thicker e-liquid, keep the wattage inside the coil's printed range and take slower draws. Check the glass O-rings are seated and the base is screwed home. Close the top airflow slightly before refilling.
How much e-liquid does the Vaporesso iTank T hold?

The UK version of the Vaporesso iTank T holds 2ml, the maximum allowed under TPD rules for a nicotine tank, and the spare glass in the box is also 2ml. The international version holds 6ml with a 3ml straight-glass option. In steady DTL use at 60W a 2ml fill lasts around an hour.
